name: Ondřej Knotek - Article 1 – alinéa 1 – point 2; Règlement (UE) 2021/1119 – Article 4 – paragraphe 5 – après le point h - Am 67
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2021/1119 establishing the framework for achieving climate neutrality
part_text: (h b) ensure that all new legislation shall be accompanied by a detailed impact assessment to assess its impact on vulnerable and low-income households in order to ensure that it does not exacerbate energy and transport poverty;
